newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish Nov trade surplus FIM 6.11 billion - customs.
newsitem.headline: Finnish Nov trade surplus FIM 6.11 billion - customs.

text.p: Finland's trade surplus rose to 6.11 billion markka in November from 2.35 billion in October, the National Customs Board (NCB) said in a statement on Tuesday.
The value of exports rose 15 percent year-on-year in November and the value of imports rose four percent, NCB said.
The Bank of Finland earlier estimated the November trade surplus at 5.6 billion markka with exports seen at 17.9 billion and imports at 12.3 billion.
The NCB's official monthly trade statistics are lagging behind due to changes in customs procedures when Finland joined the European Union at the start of 1995.
